properties.failureScenario: The package's API is only what `packages/cli/src/index.ts` exports: `Io`, `ReviewOutcome`, `reviewExitCodes`, `main`, `usage`, `usageExitCode` and `scriptVariable`. Even so, `CloneEvidence` has TSDoc on the class and on three of its methods. A contributor who goes by the rule will take TSDoc as a sign that `CloneEvidence` is public package API, which it is not.
